name: Baked Beef Enchiladas with Red Sauce and Cheese

components.name: Beef Enchiladas

ingredients.name: Eight wheat tortillas of 65 g each

steps: In a saucepan make the sauce by warming oil, whisking in flour, then slowly adding stock and passata with chilli and cumin. Simmer until lightly thickened.
In a skillet sauté onion, pepper and garlic with oil; add beef and cook until browned throughout. Stir in black beans and the dry seasonings.
Preheat oven to 185 C. Spread a little sauce over the bottom of a baking dish. Fill each tortilla with one eighth of the meat mixture and a little cheese.
Roll tightly and arrange seam side down in the dish. Pour remaining sauce over rolled enchiladas, then scatter the cheese evenly.
Bake for 20-30 minutes until the sauce bubbles and cheese melts. Rest 10 minutes.
Divide into eight complete one-wrap portions and garnish with coriander after reheating.
